description: Read-only BigQuery tools for plain-language data questions, with a cost gate on every query
name: io.github.deBilla/data-platform-mcp

environmentVariables.description: JSON map of environment name to BigQuery settings (project, location, impersonate, dataset_allowlist, byte caps). Omit when using a config file at ~/.config/data-platform-mcp/config.toml.
environmentVariables.name: BQ_MCP_ENVIRONMENTS

environmentVariables.description: Environment used when a tool call omits the environment argument.
environmentVariables.name: BQ_MCP_DEFAULT_ENVIRONMENT

environmentVariables.description: Path to a TOML config file, overriding ~/.config/data-platform-mcp/config.toml.
environmentVariables.name: BQ_MCP_CONFIG

environmentVariables.description: Read-only service account to impersonate, making read-only a property of the identity rather than of this code. Create it with `data-platform-mcp setup`.
environmentVariables.name: BQ_IMPERSONATE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT

environmentVariables.description: GCP project whose BigQuery datasets are queried. Falls back to the project associated with Application Default Credentials.
environmentVariables.name: BQ_PROJECT

environmentVariables.description: BigQuery location for jobs and datasets. Defaults to US.
environmentVariables.name: BQ_LOCATION

environmentVariables.description: Region holding BigQuery Studio notebooks and saved queries. Separate from BQ_LOCATION and usually different: code assets are regional and Dataform rejects multi-regions, so datasets in US typically pair with code assets in a region like us-central1. A wrong region returns an empty list rather than an error. Defaults to BQ_LOCATION.
environmentVariables.name: BQ_CODE_ASSET_LOCATION

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated dataset IDs the server may read. Empty means all datasets.
environmentVariables.name: BQ_DATASET_ALLOWLIST

environmentVariables.description: Scan size above which a query is returned for user confirmation instead of run. Defaults to 1 GiB.
environmentVariables.name: BQ_WARN_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Hard per-query scan cap; a query estimated above this never runs. Defaults to 5 GiB.
environmentVariables.name: BQ_MAX_BYTES_BILLED

environmentVariables.description: Path for the JSONL tool-call audit log, or 'off' to disable it. SQL text is never recorded, only a hash and a length.
environmentVariables.name: BQ_MCP_AUDIT_LOG

title: BigQuery Data Platform
